title: Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning for an Options Market Maker: An Empirical Study with Real S&P 500 Options
idea: When the 20‑day QQQ return (r20) is negative and 30‑day ATM IV (l_iv30) is above its 20‑day average, reduce the hedge ratio to 0.8‑0.9 (i.e., under‑hedge) instead of full delta; otherwise stick to delta hedging.

title: Towards Robust Reinforcement Learning Market Making: Lessons from Loss Function Experimentation
idea: Train an actor‑critic market‑making agent on NQ futures using a reward = profit – λ₁·max(0, inventory‑imax) – λ₂·max(0, cmin‑cash), where imax and cmin are set from historical inventory and cash‑flow limits; then compare its daily P&L and spread to a profit‑only baseline.
